title: Meeting the Hampton band; William Mackel
summary: In the lobby he met Jimmy Cleveland, Quincy Jones and Art Farmer, all road pros, and reserved guitarist William Mackel.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: Was there anybody in that band that you already knew? Did you have any friends in that band?

No more than I had met them, I had just met them. That's all. They weren't like friends. I had met them when they were there in Indianapolis, but I had spent my time with Charlie Mingus, who wasn't on the band any more.

And so, the next day...I made it through that night. The next day we had...there was a message for everybody to meet in the lobby. I had been understood when I got there, the road manager said, everybody was going to meet in the lobby because we're leaving that day to go to Oregon. And everybody came down with their stuff and I had my bass and my bag, and I was trying to be hip.

Hip, I mean saying the right things. And I was speaking to different ones, saying 'Hey, oh yeah, don't I remember you, yeah, man, this is Wes's brother, yeah, hey man.' The cats... so and so...and we went through the thing with...There was Jimmy Cleveland, Quincy Jones and Art Farmer. You know, the cats. Just like I couldn't imagine. Then I begin to get afraid. The kid had come down, now.

Fast! The guys, everybody looked as if they were old warhorses, road horses. You know what I mean, it looked like they were pros, road pros. They dressed ready for the ride on the bus. Everything was intact, you know. And one guy who I'll never forget as long as I live, I'll always be indebted to him, he's the guitar palyer, that Wes took his place. William Mackel, who is really an old pro. But very reserved, really reserved.

He knew where all the eating places were, he knew where all the best hotels, the best everything was. Old experienced road hog that was very reserved. He knew when to buy right. 'We don't buy here, we buy it when we get there, it's the same thing because...'
